# EU YPS Network

> European Youth Peace and Security Network (EYPS Network) — an international network of young activists, advocates, researchers, and changemakers present in more than 82 countries, advancing the United Nations Youth, Peace and Security Agenda (which the European Union helps implement).

The official website for the EU YPS / EYPS Network. Content reflects the network’s regional structure and the United Nations Youth, Peace and Security Agenda.

## Site

- [Home](https://euypsnet.org/): Overview, vision, mission, and metrics
- [Five pillars](https://euypsnet.org/pillars): Participation, Protection, Prevention, Partnerships, Disengagement and reintegration (UNSCR 2250)
- [Regions](https://euypsnet.org/regions): West Africa, Central Africa, Eastern and Southern Africa, Europe, Latin America and the Caribbean, Asia and the Middle East
- [Meet the Team](https://euypsnet.org/team): Regional Administrators and coordinators
- [Activities](https://euypsnet.org/activities): Dialogue, inclusion, capacity-building and networks
- [Resources](https://euypsnet.org/resources): Downloadable briefs, toolkits, and training notes
- [Join](https://euypsnet.org/join): Contact the network by email

## Key facts

- Name: European Youth Peace and Security Network (EYPS Network)
- Short name: EU YPS Network
- Founded: 2025
- Contact: euypsnet@gmail.com
- Domain: https://euypsnet.org
- Location reference: Brussels, Belgium
- Languages on site: English (https://euypsnet.org/), Arabic (https://euypsnet.org/ar)
